verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents building server-side voice agents in Python or Node.js, with automatic turn detection and interruption handling. That implies realtime audio in and speech out. Participant tokens carry publish capabilities such as canPublish, but the pack never explicitly says the agent joins the room as a participant that subscribes to live audio and publishes synthesized speech tracks. Missing for 10: explicit docs of the agent joining as a room participant, documented audio-track subscription and speech publishing flow, independent hands-on corroboration of realtime latency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a server-side agent joins a session as a participant that receives live audio and publishes speech back in realtime

citations.quote: Build a simple voice agent with Python or Node.js in less than 10 minutes.
